## Episode Thesis

This Danish episode of Store Penge covers macro and geopolitics, not individual stocks. Guest Mikkel Rosenvold (Real Vision) thinks the US-Iran fight over the Strait of Hormuz is still contained, and he expects Iran to become more willing to make a deal in about 1-1.5 months. He says Fed chair Kevin Walsh at Jackson Hole kept a September rate hike on the table, which makes the 15-16 September meeting a coin toss for the AI trade. His macro call is a weaker dollar, favouring bitcoin and gold. The rest of the episode criticises ATP's risk-taking and board, and says the Danish Finance Ministry's fiscal forecasts are too conservative.
